about_the_game:
The world view of "Evraco" is the same as that of another game "Eternal Liiivie" and "Tentacles Party with Nuns" on the Steam store page, but the era and worldline are different.

This setting book is to make up for setting details that are not mentioned in the game.

Even if you don’t watch it, it won’t affect your gaming experience

But it can help some players interested in settings and details, or the worldview to understand the detailed content better.

For PNG and Word files

Contains some words from the designers as well as design ideas and details.

(PNG)

content_descriptors.notes: Contains some nudity, physical contact, and sexual contents
